open_release.rationale: The introduction cites confidentiality as motivation, but no release or privacy evaluation is made for RTSGAN itself.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No testing or format-conformance framing appears.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Synthetic data utility is evaluated by training downstream models on synthetic data and testing on real data.

quotes.text: Experiments on the four RTS datasets show that the proposed framework outperforms the previous generation methods in terms of synthetic data utility for downstream classification and prediction tasks.

statistical_replication.rationale: The method aims to respect original feature distributions and is evaluated for realistic-looking data.

quotes.text: By combining the generator and the decoder, RTSGAN is able to generate RTS which respect the original feature distributions and the temporal dynamics.

education.rationale: No teaching framing appears; the README is experiment code.

benchmarking.rationale: RTSGAN is the proposed method and the sources do not show it used as a baseline.
